prose: Bloomberg's newsletter reports a study finding that AI shopping assistants such as Claude and ChatGPT can present different prices depending on how wealthy the user appears. The page could not be fetched because Bloomberg blocked access, so this entry is based on the headline and the Hacker News listing only.

Basis: headline. Details such as how wealth was signalled, which products were tested and the size of the differences are not available here. It is a natural companion to Cory Doctorow's essay on price discrimination published the same day.
highlights: Study says AI shopping bots quote different prices by user wealth
Covers Claude and ChatGPT, per the headline
Source blocked: method and numbers unknown to this summary
